sources.fullCitation: Archiwum Uniwersytetu Warszawskiego, Bronisław Kaper student file, RP 6854. Aggregate archival source for documents from Kaper’s University of Warsaw student file, including the young portrait, University of Warsaw matriculation and study records, the police certificate of 21 April 1920 recording his religion as Mosaic, and the baptism record/certificate concerning St Alexander’s Church, 17 July 1920. No public URL; used with permission / archival consultation.
